product_description: Enjoy a delicious keto friendly snack with KIND ZEROg Added Sugar Granola. Each 8-ounce bag of nut granola clusters contains 3g total sugar, 4g net carbs, 5g protein with 0g* added sugar per serving. This gluten free granola is made with nutrient dense nuts, including #1 ingredient almonds, instead of grains, with the addition of crunchy pecans, sunflower seeds, cinnamon, and dried fruit for some sweetness. We use no artificial sweeteners or sugar alcohols. Keep a bag in your pantry for when you crave a convenient snack. Pair these crunchy granola clusters with your choice of yogurt or a smoothie bowl as part of your breakfast. The portable, resealable bag makes it easy to enjoy our granola on the go. Consider ZEROg Added Sugar KIND Granola as a delicious, nutritious addition to your keto friendly journey. Healthy snacks are smarter snacks. Snack KIND! *Not a low-calorie food.
